entities.summary: Javier Moscoso del Prado y Muñoz was a Spanish politician who served as Minister of the Presidency from December 1982 to July 1986 and as Attorney General of the State from September 1986 to January 1990. Moscoso died on 16 July 2025, at the age of 90.
